note: Not listed, equivalent: 'forcing for one safe move too' (with one safe move the filter's fallback (`or safe`) keeps it, so the length check only saves work); 'a board-filling reply is a threat' (a reply can fill the board only when it is the opponent's one reply, so the count is at most 1 either way (the check was removed)). 'losses before wins' (ranking a tie by losing in two before winning in two orders the moves the same way: a move winning by force in two never loses by force in two, so the three classes keep their order); 'an answer ending the game leaves no win in two' (a finished game has no legal moves, so it leaves no immediate win either way (the check was removed)). For phases: 'the switch dropped alone in simplify' (simplify tries dropping the second phase whole first; dropping only the switch plays as that does, so it can never succeed where the whole drop failed — the cell loop skips the switch to save that walk); 'the second phase reads the switch key' (the switch's own key maps to -1, never a cell).
